ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) base surface covering approximately 90% of the visible fluke area, with high-intensity (white) pixels forming localized circular patterns with a contrast ratio of approximately 8:1 relative to the background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Macro-level dark pigmentation field populated by thousands of discrete, high-contrast white annular (ring-like) and solid circular blobs (3-15 pixels in diameter) scattered across both lobes with higher density toward the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A shallow, obtuse V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 120 degrees and a vertical depth of approximately 45 pixels from the highest lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations along the continuous trailing boundary, characterized by peaks of 5-12 pixel amplitudes and asymmetrical valleys, distinct from the smooth water background interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward convex curves (convexity oriented dorsally) extending from the median notch to the distal tips, following a standard parabolic arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular, high-contrast pixel rings (rosette scars) distributed semi-randomly across the entire ventral surface, representing high-frequency localized intensity disruptions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse detection of thin, unaligned linear white pixel segments (30-50 pixels in length) on the medial section of the right lobe, oriented at roughly a 45-degree angle to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized irregular notches and jagged tissue discontinuities on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, characterized by deep pixel-level indentations into the lobe body.
other_distinctive_markers: The density and uniformity of the annular ring-scars create a unique 'speckled' or 'ringed' texture that serves as a highly distinctive visual identifier.
